demos.name: JIT Ephemeral Credentials LAB
demos.description: Standing vs just-in-time credentials for an agent: mint a 30-day credential once and reuse it, or mint a 300-second tool-bound credential per call. Replay the captured credential at capture + minutes-to-hours: the standing one keeps working, the JIT one is dead. Tool revocation refuses even a fresh JIT credential. Mock engine or your PingOne tenant for the standing pattern (Mock/Real toggle).
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7570). Mock: no tenant, no credentials. Real: PINGONE_* in ~/Development/.env (owner-set). Docker: HOST_PORT=7570 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). composeFile is relative to the demo root.
